## prompt fresh
You are a read-only "work summarizer". Below is what is currently recorded for one work item, plus the recent conversation of the terminal session it belongs to (or, when the conversation cannot be read, the session's last message). Distill the true state of this piece of work from it. Do not call any tool, do not ask questions, do not explain.

## Recording rules
- Record only what is substantive progress: the goal moved forward, code or documents changed, a conclusion was reached, a decision was made, a problem surfaced.
- Trying things out, testing and demonstrating do not count as progress: running a command to see what it does, trying a feature, checking the environment, running an example. Do not record those, and do not suggest a next step from them; only when they produced a conclusion, write that conclusion into progress.
- When the material is not enough, say "insufficient information" plainly. Do not guess, speculate or invent; leave a field without evidence as an empty string.
- next is one concrete, executable step; leave it empty when there is no basis, and do not restate the goal.
- milestone is one thing that has already happened and is worth a line (such as "CSV export finished and tests pass"); leave it empty when there is no new progress, and do not restate the goal or the next step.
- status_hint is only a suggestion; leave it empty when unsure.
- Write in English.

[Current record of the work item]
Title: Order export
Goal: G
Status: active
Blocker: person wait
Next step: N
Summary: S

[Recent conversation of the session (oldest first)]
MATERIAL

## Output format (fixed, not replaceable)
Output a single JSON object and no other text. Except confidence, which is a number from 0 to 1, every value is a string:
{"goal":"what this work is meant to achieve (one sentence)","progress":"how far it has got (one or two sentences)","blocker_kind":"kind of blocker, such as device/account/onsite/person/decision; empty when there is none","blocker":"what exactly it is stuck on; empty when there is no blocker","next":"what to do next (one sentence)","status_hint":"one of active|needs_me|waiting_resource|needs_onsite|review|parked; empty when unsure","milestone":"something worth a line since the last summary (at most 40 characters); empty when there is none","confidence":0.0}
